text:
maria_g: heads-up — we started seeing a spike in OOMs on the paged-attn tier around 15:02 UTC. p90 latency up ~30% and compaction stall events increased.
aj: ouch. any recent rollouts? :thinking_face:
maria_g: pushed a blockmgr change last night: dynamic-block-split with lower threshold (old 64->new 48). was trying to reduce block fragmentation for tiny requests.
lee_w: that PR also toggled kernel routing to prefer 'contig-opt' for >128 tokens. could be interacting badly with KV cache layout.
perf-bot: quick profile (nsys):
```
GPU memory ops per sec: +42%
KV cache miss rate: 18% -> 36%
Compaction time p95: 130ms -> 410ms
Kernel switch count per request: 1.8 -> 3.6
```
ramon: that KV miss jump explains cost. dynamic split creating many small blocks => more compaction and higher fragmentation, causing more eviction churn.
aj: hypothesis: small-block promotion threshold too aggressive. also batch headroom reduced so workspace sizing under microbursts is inadequate.
maria_g: agree. proposal: revert dynamic-split threshold to 64, and add short-term mitigation: throttle compaction on hot path (defer background compaction by 200ms) + bump per-stream reserve by 8MB.
lee_w: sounds reasonable. can we also change kernel routing to prefer 'kv-friendly' kernel when block size variance > 2x? cheap check in routing layer.
amon: i'll run an A/B on a small fleet with these three changes: revert threshold, defer compaction, +reserve. run for 2h and compare p95/p99 and OOM count.
aj: also add a lightweight probe that samples last-use timestamp per-block to bias reuse — should reduce unnecessary compaction. cheap counter only.
maria_g: can you sketch the config diff? small snippet works.
aj: 
```
blockmgr:
  dynamic_split_threshold: 64  # was 48
  compaction:
    defer_ms_on_hotpath: 200
workspace:
  per_stream_reserve_mb: 8
kernel_routing:
  prefer_kv_friendly_if_block_variance_ratio: 2
```
maria_g: nice. ramon, ping me when the A/B is live.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: blockmgr-revert+compaction-delay+reserve -> canary (fleet: paged-attn-canary-3) at 15:28 UTC
ramon: canary up at 15:34. initial 30m looks promising: p95 down ~12%, compaction time p95 down to ~160ms, KV miss trending down.
maria_g: excellent. keep running full 2h and collect traces. if stable, let's cut a patch and roll to main fleet with small ramp.
lee_w: follow-up: we should add an offline sim that replays microburst token distributions to surface this earlier. adding to perf-qa backlog.
perf-bot: note added to perf-qa: replay-microburst-variance (#1234)
maria_g: thanks team. next steps: ramon to finish 2h run + bundle nsight captures, aj to open PR with last-use probe + routing tweak, lee to add sim plan.
